error_message: cloudflared: Failed to dial a quic connection error="timeout: handshake did not complete in time"; tunnel never registered
root_cause: QUIC uses UDP 7844 which is blocked/throttled on this network, so the quick-tunnel edge handshake times out
fix: Run cloudflared with --protocol http2 to force the TCP/443 transport instead of QUIC

error_message: Tunnel returns HTTP 403 while localhost:5181 returns 200 for the same request
root_cause: Vite 5.4.21 host-header check (server.allowedHosts, added in the 5.4.12 CVE fix) rejects the *.trycloudflare.com Host with 403
fix: Add allowedHosts: [".trycloudflare.com"] to server config in vite.config.ts

error_message: XSS via javascript: URL in href (security review, OnboardingButton)
root_cause: cta.url rendered directly in <a href> without scheme validation; admin-configurable source
fix: added safeHttpUrl() guard, only allow http/https, return null otherwise

root_cause: Lantai doctype has reqd field 'sekolah' (ADR-0042 multi-tenant, no fetch_from from gedung), but create payload only sent {nama, nomor_lantai, gedung}
fix: Added useSessionStore activeSekolah.name, included sekolah in create payload + guard, matching GedungFormModal pattern. Updated test mock + expected payload; added afterEach(cleanup) to fix pre-existing modal test isolation (duplicate Simpan)

error_message: /{slug}/master/unit-jenjang shows all schools' Unit Jenjang (30 rows) instead of only the active sekolah (6)
root_cause: Unit Jenjang was in TENANT_BLOCKLIST (mislabeled as having no sekolah field), so injectSekolahFilter skipped it — no [sekolah,=,active] filter added. Backend permission_query_conditions also missing Unit Jenjang (cross-org leak for non-super users); Administrator bypasses pqc anyway as super-role.
fix: Removed 'Unit Jenjang' from TENANT_BLOCKLIST so client auto-injects the sekolah filter (verified: 6 vs 30). Backend: added pqc_unit_jenjang callback in tenant_scope.py + registered 'Unit Jenjang' in permission_query_conditions (hooks.py) for defense-in-depth.
